scientific_integrity: The original bi-uniform probability law and variance gap are credited to Groß. Only the full strict convex order and strict stop-loss comparisons are presented as the new statement.
scientific_limitations: The comparison is for the specific two-level law, its convex mixtures, integer n >= 2, and 0 < p < 1. No ordinary stochastic tail ordering, comparison to beta-binomial laws, or independent external audit is claimed.
title: Strict convex-order dispersion in the bi-uniform binomial mixture
